name: hxn-gpu
description: One GPU API for Haxe over the hxn GPU drivers: Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D 12, OpenGL ES, WebGPU and WebGL2, with features and limits per device
releasenote: Blend what a render pipeline draws, write part of a texture, set viewports and scissors, keep a pass's target, read vertex buffers from an offset, draw into several color targets in one pass, and test and write depth. Read four normalized bytes as a vertex attribute, and set whether presents wait for the display's refresh. writeBuffer waits only for the work that uses the buffer. GLES and WebGL2 frames are upright. Vulkan frames present in the format that the window's surface offers, which on Android is RGBA. Needs hxn-gpu-metal 0.2.4, -vulkan 0.3.4, -d3d12 0.2.3, -gles 0.3.3, -webgpu 0.3.6, -webgl2 0.3.5.
